summary: 3D shadow-theatre light puzzle with Karagöz and Hacivat, redesigned with a lamp-lit linen screen, maroon drapes and a walnut UI, built by Claude Opus 5.5 · Karagöz ve Hacivat'lı 3D gölge oyunu ışık bulmacası, lamba ışığında keten perde, bordo perdeler ve ceviz arayüzle yeniden tasarlandı, Claude Opus 5.5 yaptı
key_features: Point-light shadow optics: near the lamp a big soft shadow, near the cloth a small sharp one; coloured leather and glass lamps mix colours
Redesign: a lamp-lit linen screen, a stained-glass leather look on the puppets, maroon drapes with tassels and a carved arch
Redesign: a coffee-house room with İznik tiles, kilims, lanterns and nargile smoke, and a leather and walnut UI on every screen
24 scenes in 4 acts and 72 stars; the ?auto bot solves 24/24 with 64/72 stars and 0 JS errors
Measured after the redesign: static scenes 60 fps with 28-32 draw calls; timed act IV scenes 39 fps as before (60 with ?low)
